name: Csharp Async Patterns
description: Guides expert-level C# async programming: async/await pitfalls, ValueTask vs Task decision tree, CancellationToken patterns, IAsyncEnumerable, and ConfigureAwait considerations. Use when the user asks about C# async, await, ValueTask, Task, CancellationToken, IAsyncEnumerable, ConfigureAwait, async patterns. Do NOT use when the user asks about C# modern idioms (use `csharp-modern-idioms`), C# performance (use `csharp-performance`), C# ASP.NET (use `csharp-aspnet-patterns`).
